title: New MSFS 2024 activities! 747 captain, A320 ops & historic WWII flying this week
description:
🔍 Description
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (7 February 2026) brings an exciting set of new PC activities — and the standout addition is the 747 Captain – Virgin Atlantic long‑haul experience from Perfect Flight. Whether you're into airliner ops, scenic adventures, or historical missions, this week has something special waiting for you.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 747 Captain - Virgin Atlantic (Long‑haul airline missions)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain Master Collection (Airline operations experience)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Above the Sky Master Collection (High-altitude scenic flying)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air WWII Operation Market Garden (Historical war mission pack)

If you enjoy the video, don’t forget to drop a like, hit subscribe, and let me know in the comments which activity you’ll be flying first!
Thanks for watching 

✈️ See you in the skies!
